ucs.title: [LLM] RansomHub EDRKillShifter — BYOVD driver staged to user-writable path + driver service registration
ucs.description: Hunts RansomHub affiliates' signature EDR-killer loader (EDRKillShifter and TDSSKiller variants) by correlating a .sys file dropped into Temp/ProgramData/Public/Downloads with a near-simultaneous registry write that registers that file as a Windows kernel-mode service. The drop-then-service-register pattern within ~60s is the BYOVD chain RansomHub uses before deploying their encryptor.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.file_path) as file_paths values(Filesystem.process_name) as loader_proc from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_name="*.sys" (Filesystem.file_path="*\\Temp\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\ProgramData\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Users\\Public\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Downloads\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.process_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
| where NOT match(process_name, "(?i)^(TrustedInstaller|msiexec|drvinst|svchost|wuauclt)\.exe$")
| join type=inner dest [ | tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as svc_time values(Registry.registry_value_data) as svc_image_paths values(Registry.registry_path) as svc_keys from datamodel=Endpoint.Registry where Registry.registry_path="*\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\*" Registry.registry_value_name="ImagePath" (Registry.registry_value_data="*\\Temp\\*.sys" OR Registry.registry_value_data="*\\ProgramData\\*.sys" OR Registry.registry_value_data="*\\Public\\*.sys" OR Registry.registry_value_data="*\\AppData\\*.sys" OR Registry.registry_value_data="*\\Downloads\\*.sys") by Registry.dest | `drop_dm_object_name(Registry)` ]
| where abs(firstTime - svc_time) <= 120
| table firstTime svc_time dest user loader_proc file_paths svc_keys svc_image_paths
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let DrvWrites = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName endswith ".sys"
    | where FolderPath has_any (@"\Temp\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\Downloads\")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("TrustedInstaller.exe","msiexec.exe","drvinst.exe","svchost.exe","wuauclt.exe")
    | project DropTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, DriverPath = FolderPath, DriverFileName = FileName,
              LoaderImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath, LoaderCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              LoaderSHA256 = InitiatingProcessSHA256;
let SvcKeys = DeviceRegistryEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where RegistryKey has @"\CurrentControlSet\Services\"
    | where RegistryValueName =~ "ImagePath"
    | where RegistryValueData has ".sys"
    | where RegistryValueData has_any (@"\Temp\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Public\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\Downloads\")
    | project SvcTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, ServiceKey = RegistryKey, ServiceImagePath = RegistryValueData,
              SvcInitProc = InitiatingProcessFileName, SvcInitCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
DrvWrites
| join kind=inner SvcKeys on DeviceId
| where abs(datetime_diff('second', SvcTime, DropTime)) <= 120
| project DropTime, SvcTime, DeviceName, DriverPath, DriverFileName, LoaderImage, LoaderCmd, LoaderSHA256, ServiceKey, ServiceImagePath, SvcInitProc, SvcInitCmd
| order by DropTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let DrvWrites = ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where TargetFileName endswith ".sys"
    | where TargetFilePath has_any (@"\Temp\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\Downloads\")
    | where ActingProcessName !in~ ("TrustedInstaller.exe","msiexec.exe","drvinst.exe","svchost.exe","wuauclt.exe")
    | project DropTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, TargetFilePath, TargetFileName, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine;
let SvcKeys = ImRegistryEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where RegistryKey has @"\CurrentControlSet\Services\"
    | where RegistryValue =~ "ImagePath"
    | where RegistryValueData has ".sys"
    | where RegistryValueData has_any (@"\Temp\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Public\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\Downloads\")
    | project SvcTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, RegistryKey, RegistryValueData, SvcInitProc = ActingProcessName, SvcInitCmd = ActingProcessCommandLine;
DrvWrites
| join kind=inner SvcKeys on DvcHostname
| where abs(datetime_diff('second', SvcTime, DropTime)) <= 120
| project DropTime, SvcTime, DvcHostname, TargetFilePath, TargetFileName, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine, RegistryKey, RegistryValueData, SvcInitProc, SvcInitCmd
| order by DropTime desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Kernel driver (.sys) written to user-writable path - possible RansomHub BYOVD loader
id: a7c5c8e2-1f0a-4f78-9b6e-2c0e1f5e3d22
status: experimental
description: Detects a .sys kernel driver written under Temp / ProgramData / Public / Downloads / AppData\Local\Temp by a non-installer process — a staging pattern used by RansomHub's EDRKillShifter and TDSSKiller-style BYOVD loaders prior to driver service registration.
references:
  - https://news.sophos.com/en-us/2024/08/14/edrkillshifter/
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa24-242a
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/19
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.sys'
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '\Temp\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
      - '\Users\Public\'
      - '\Downloads\'
      - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
  filter_legit_installers:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\TrustedInstaller.exe'
      - '\msiexec.exe'
      - '\drvinst.exe'
      - '\svchost.exe'
      - '\wuauclt.exe'
  condition: selection and not filter_legit_installers
falsepositives:
  - Niche driver-update utilities staging signed drivers to %TEMP%
  - Hardware vendor first-run installers running outside MSI context
level: high
tags:
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1562.001
  - attack.t1014
  - attack.t1543.003
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 @TargetFilename:(*\\Temp\\*.sys OR *\\TEMP\\*.SYS OR *\\ProgramData\\*.sys OR *\\PROGRAMDATA\\*.SYS OR *\\Public\\*.sys OR *\\PUBLIC\\*.SYS OR *\\Downloads\\*.sys OR *\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*.sys) -@Image:(*\\TrustedInstaller.exe OR *\\trustedinstaller.exe OR *\\msiexec.exe OR *\\MsiExec.exe OR *\\drvinst.exe OR *\\svchost.exe OR *\\wuauclt.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten TargetFileName=/\\(Temp|ProgramData|Users\\\\Public|Downloads|AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp)\\\\[^\\\\]+\.sys$/i
| NOT ContextImageFileName=/\\(TrustedInstaller|msiexec|drvinst|svchost|wuauclt)\.exe$/i
| join({#event_simpleName=AsepValueUpdate RegObjectName=/\\CurrentControlSet\\\\Services\\\\/i RegValueName="ImagePath" RegStringValue=/\\(Temp|ProgramData|Public|Downloads|AppData)\\\\.+\.sys/i}, field=aid, include=[RegObjectName, RegStringValue, RegValueName])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, TargetFileName, ContextImageFileName, RegObjectName, RegStringValue], function=count())
ucs.rationale: Drop-and-register correlation under 2 minutes is RansomHub-affiliate-specific because EDRKillShifter (Sophos/CrowdStrike-tracked as the RansomHub EDR-killer of choice) and TDSSKiller abuse both stage a renamed vulnerable signed driver in a user-writable path and register it via Service Control Manager registry write before the encryptor stage. Legitimate driver installs route through TrustedInstal

ucs.title: [LLM] RansomHub ScreenConnect (CVE-2024-1709) chain — ConnectWise client spawning RMM-tool deployment
ucs.description: Hunts the RansomHub initial-access → install pivot: ScreenConnect/ConnectWise client service (commonly exploited via the AuthBypass CVE-2024-1709) spawning shell/MSI/script processes that deploy secondary RMM agents (Atera, Splashtop, AnyDesk) — the RMM-piggybacking pattern flagged in the CISA #StopRansomware AA24-242A RansomHub advisory.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.process_path) as image_paths from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name="ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe" OR Processes.parent_process_name="ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe" OR Processes.parent_process_name="ScreenConnect.Service.exe") (Processes.process_name="msiexec.exe" OR Processes.process_name="powershell.exe" OR Processes.process_name="pwsh.exe" OR Processes.process_name="cmd.exe" OR Processes.process_name="certutil.exe" OR Processes.process_name="bitsadmin.exe" OR Processes.process_name="curl.exe" OR Processes.process_name="mshta.exe" OR Processes.process_name="rundll32.exe" OR Processes.process_name="regsvr32.exe") (Processes.process="*AteraAgent*" OR Processes.process="*atera.com*" OR Processes.process="*splashtop*" OR Processes.process="*SRServer*" OR Processes.process="*SRManualLauncher*" OR Processes.process="*anydesk*" OR Processes.process="*AnyDesk*" OR Processes.process="*DownloadString*" OR Processes.process="*Invoke-Expression*" OR Processes.process="*-EncodedCommand*" OR Processes.process="*Start-BitsTransfer*" OR Processes.process="*msiexec*http*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| table firstTime lastTime dest user parent_process_name process_name image_paths cmdlines
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe","ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe","ScreenConnect.Service.exe")
| where FileName in~ ("msiexec.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","curl.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("AteraAgent","atera.com","setup.atera","splashtop","SRServer","SRManualLauncher","anydesk","AnyDesk","DownloadString","Invoke-Expression","-EncodedCommand","Start-BitsTransfer","msiexec /i http","msiexec /i https")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where ParentProcessName has_any ("ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe","ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe","ScreenConnect.Service.exe")
| where TargetProcessName in~ ("msiexec.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","curl.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe")
| where TargetProcessCommandLine has_any ("AteraAgent","atera.com","setup.atera","splashtop","SRServer","SRManualLauncher","anydesk","AnyDesk","DownloadString","Invoke-Expression","-EncodedCommand","Start-BitsTransfer","msiexec /i http")
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
          ParentImage = ParentProcessName,
          ParentCmd = ParentProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage = TargetProcessName,
          ChildCmd = TargetProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: RansomHub ScreenConnect-to-RMM deployment chain
id: e3f1a9b4-9c2d-4d3a-b7f8-7e0c1a4b5c66
status: experimental
description: ScreenConnect/ConnectWise client service spawning a script/installer that pulls Atera, Splashtop or AnyDesk — the secondary-RMM-deployment pattern RansomHub affiliates use after CVE-2024-1709 AuthBypass exploitation.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa24-242a
  - https://www.connectwise.com/company/trust/security-bulletins/connectwise-screenconnect-23.9.8
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/19
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe'
      - '\ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe'
      - '\ScreenConnect.Service.exe'
  child_image:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\msiexec.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\certutil.exe'
      - '\bitsadmin.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
  child_intent:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'AteraAgent'
      - 'atera.com'
      - 'setup.atera'
      - 'splashtop'
      - 'SRServer'
      - 'SRManualLauncher'
      - 'anydesk'
      - 'AnyDesk'
      - 'DownloadString'
      - 'Invoke-Expression'
      - '-EncodedCommand'
      - 'Start-BitsTransfer'
      - 'msiexec /i http'
  condition: parent and child_image and child_intent
falsepositives:
  - MSP technician legitimately installing approved secondary RMM via ScreenConnect session (validate against change-management ticket)
level: high
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1219
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1218
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe OR *\\ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe OR *\\ScreenConnect.Service.exe OR *\\SCREENCONNECT.CLIENTSERVICE.EXE OR *\\screenconnect.clientservice.exe) @Image:(*\\msiexec.exe OR *\\MsiExec.exe OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\cmd.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\certutil.exe OR *\\bitsadmin.exe OR *\\curl.exe OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\rundll32.exe OR *\\regsvr32.exe) @CommandLine:(*AteraAgent* OR *atera.com* OR *setup.atera* OR *splashtop* OR *SRServer* OR *SRManualLauncher* OR *anydesk* OR *AnyDesk* OR *DownloadString* OR *Invoke-Expression* OR *EncodedCommand* OR *Start-BitsTransfer* OR "*msiexec /i http*")
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/ScreenConnect\.(ClientService|WindowsClient|Service)\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(msiexec|powershell|pwsh|cmd|certutil|bitsadmin|curl|mshta|rundll32|regsvr32)\.exe$/i
| CommandLine=/AteraAgent|atera\.com|setup\.atera|splashtop|SRServer|SRManualLauncher|anydesk|DownloadString|Invoke-Expression|EncodedCommand|Start-BitsTransfer|msiexec\s+\/i\s+https?:/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName], function=count())
ucs.rationale: CISA AA24-242A explicitly calls out RansomHub affiliates using CVE-2024-1709 (ScreenConnect AuthBypass) for initial access and then dropping Atera / Splashtop / AnyDesk as their persistence/access redundancy stack — distinct from LockBit (which favors Cobalt Strike beacon staging) and ALPHV/BlackCat (heavier on legitimate-admin tool repurposing). The parent-child constraint pins it to ScreenConnec
